items.title: Marshall Lawrence Interview, 1960-06-28
items.q: Edmund told me he had an uncle who played guitar, banjo or something.

ctx.x: See when Clarence left, we took Herbert in his place. And he just picked it up and in a little while he could read faster than the uncles.
Edmund told me he had an uncle who played guitar, banjo or something.
Yeah, he had an uncle who played a guitar.
